import re


def slugify(text):
    text = text.strip().lower()
    # Replace non-alphanumeric characters with hyphen, then collapse multiple hyphens
    text = re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]", "-", text)
    # Collapse multiple consecutive hyphens into one
    text = re.sub(r"-+", "-", text)
    # Remove leading and trailing hyphens
    return text.strip("-")


def truncate(text, n):
    if len(text) <= n:
        return text
    return text[: n - 3] + "..."
